gap: Unticking and re-ticking an OLD occurrence after the series has ended forks it. SEED (the recur-check 'ends after 3' seed): clock 2026-03-10 09:00 America/New_York, things-todos=[{id:'t1',title:'Physio exercises',when:'2026-03-11',repeat:{mode:'completion',every:1,unit:'day',ends:{after:3}}}], route #/upcoming. STEPS: (1) click the open row's checkbox 3 times -> t1 (occ1), occ2, occ3 all completed, none open (correct). (2) #/logbook: click t1's checkbox (untick). (3) #/upcoming: click t1's checkbox (tick again). Same with keyboard: in the Logbook click t1's label to select it and press Cmd/Ctrl+K twice. EXPECTED: untick+retick is a no-op: 3 to-dos, 0 open. Contract: 'ends.after is the total number of occurrences in the series, counting the first'; the Logbook reopen must not fork the series (on a live series the engine does this right: the reopened one comes back as a one-off and re-ticking spawns nothing). ACTUAL (localStorage): 4 to-dos in series t1: t1 [x] nextId->new, a NEW open 'Physio exercises' occurrence:2 dated 2026-03-11, plus the old occ2 [x] and occ3 [x]. So two occurrence-2 to-dos, the series has come back to life, and ends.after is exceeded (it can reach 5). Same with the 'ends on' seed (Take antibiotics, schedule daily from 2026-03-10, ends.on 2026-03-12): after completing Mar 10/11/12, untick Mar 10 in the Logbook and re-tick it in Today. That gives a second 2026-03-11 occurrence (open) next to the completed Mar 11 one. The same revival also happens after the open occurrence is deleted, which the contract says ends the series. CAUSE: store.js reopen() strips the rule only when another OPEN repeating occurrence exists (line 336). An ended series has none, so t1 keeps its repeat with occurrence 1, and complete() spawns occ 2 again without seeing that t1's successor (nextId) already exists as a completed to-do. Reproduced 2 of 2 from clean start. Not caught by recur-check, whose invariant only counts open repeating to-dos.
why: Re-ticking an old occurrence of an ended series spawns a duplicate occurrence and exceeds ends.after, by row checkbox or by Cmd/Ctrl+K twice in the Logbook
